scope: Analytical development experiment on previously seen scene families. No independent clinical holdout, neural inference, RGB or product execution.
inputs: Finite observed source points, supplied unique integer (row,column) IDs, declared pitch 5 mm, explicit allowed cells. Pitch and IDs are assumptions, not verified truth.

homography.horizon_guard: same nonzero denominator sign over observed source hull

residual.domain: complete rectangular ID lattice, including unobserved latent vertices
residual.penalty: sum squared horizontal and vertical second differences plus twice squared mixed first differences
residual.fit: four deterministic IRLS updates, residual weight min(1,1mm/norm)
residual.map: Shared piecewise affine T from canonical+smoothed_residual to canonical, composed with H. No local per-cell homographies.

selection.heldout_use: Only validate predicted normalized source coordinates at withheld supplied IDs. Heldout source points are excluded from H fitting and residual fitting. Canonical ID basis is fixed independently of source coordinates.
selection.rule: minimum mean fold loss, then first candidate in frozen complexity order within one standard error of that minimum
selection.failure: A failed fold has clipped loss 4. If all candidates fail, explicit rejection. Selected full refit is never replaced by a gold-chosen candidate.

geometry_guards.support: Intersection of original complete observed-cell support and fitted complex. Holes and exterior remain unsupported.
geometry_guards.topology: Original lattice triangles. Reject mixed triangle orientation, degenerate triangles, any positive-area source overlap and target overlap, topology-changing normalization, projective horizons. Inverse uses same triangles and validates forward cycle.
geometry_guards.uncertainty: Input-derived fold RMSE and candidate disagreement, both uncalibrated. Never certify identity, scale, orientation or physical error.

measurements: G W C R at 0.5mm on fixed physical queries
RMSE p95 p99 max conditional on support
all candidates retained, including rejected candidates
guard_controls: gold perturbation cannot alter selected candidate
prohibited: no tuning after inspecting physical query scores
no model selection from scoring truth
no masking an error by calling support uncertainty
no statement of state of the art or external clinical superiority
no claim CV can verify coherent integer IDs or pitch
